question: Can temporal task supervision repair A2-392 clearance dynamics, state transitions, and abstention without changing resolution, backbone, quantization partition, or runtime cadence?

model.backbone: unchanged A2 DA V2 Metric ViT-S
model.temporal_head: non-recurrent 4x4 pooled log-depth pair MLP; three clearance deltas, per-band 9-way state transitions, and per-band UNKNOWN logits

clip_contract.timestamp: source-native integer nanoseconds; never frame index or inferred FPS

clearance_delta.definition: C_t - C_t-1 for left, center, and right bands

training.checkpoint_selection: lowest fixed composite loss on training-only video-parent-disjoint validation clips; ties choose earliest epoch

new_clip_p1.target_bundle: separate sealed bundle unavailable to trainer
new_clip_p1.statistical_units: clip metrics and transition rows with video-parent cluster bootstrap
new_clip_p1.confidence_interval: one-sided 95 percent, 10000 deterministic parent-cluster bootstrap draws
new_clip_p1.pass_rule: all static-depth, clearance-delta, transition, abstention, false-clear, and validity gates; no weighted compensation

promotion_sequence: single opening of new clip-based P1
stack already frozen A5S selective W8A16 only after pass
reconfirm quality noninferiority on a separately prebound gate
device chain canary at one fixed cadence
cadence search only after chain canary closure and new authorization

first_device_chain_cadence_hz.purpose: link executability only; not cadence optimization

forbidden: search block skip or layer removal locations
open or reuse legacy P1 for loss, checkpoint, threshold, or model selection
open new clip P1 before checkpoint and candidate cache hashes are locked
train temporal student while tuning W8A16, teacher cadence, QNN conversion, or Android runtime
lower clip, parent, transition, false-clear, or abstention gates after opening
substitute frames for missing clips or count correlated frames as independent evidence
